title: DST Dana RS stuck at reading history
symptom: After DST, AAPS is stuck at reading the pump history. Manually fixing the pump time and resetting APS databases did nothing. The message disappears after some time, but looping and setting temp ratios do not work. Users cannot bolus.
cause: The issue may be caused by communication affected by a connected smartwatch if the phone's Bluetooth stack is not good.
fix: The solution is to delete history in DanaRS. The procedure is: go to pump, unlock, then while pressing - at the same time press + sign and arrow, appears password 0000, then enter 4, 9, 8, 9 in that order, then message then delete history. Alternatively, manually bolusing on the pump helps. Also, disabling wifi from the watch improved the issue.
evidence_quote: The solution is “delete history” in DanaRS. The procedure is 1. go to pump 2. Unlock 3. Then while pressing - at the same time press + sign and arrow 4. Appears password 0000 5. Go to third 0 and put 4 6. Go to fourth 0 put 9 7. Go to first 0 put 8 8. Go to second 0 put 9 9. All in this order 10. Message then delete history.
